test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: 15 boys can complete a work in 10 days and 12 girls can complete the same work in 15 days. If all 15 boys and 12 girls work together, in how many days, will the work get completed?
solution:
**Given:**

15 boys can complete the work in 10 days

12 girls can complete the work in 15 days

**Concept used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of 15 boys = 1/10

The efficiency of 12 girls = 1/15

Total Efficiency = 1/Total time

Total efficiency = Efficiency of 15 boys + Efficiency of 12 girls

⇒ 1/Total time = 1/10 + 1/15

⇒ 1/Total time = (3 + 2)/30 

⇒ 1/Total time = 5/30 

⇒ 1/Total time = 1/6

⇒ Total time = 6 days

**∴ 15 boys and 12 girls work together and complete the work in 6 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e28cc3eb434f17ca093117e3c009312321d7b72bbbe9cffc8696bcc8944b6067.png] 

Efficiency of 15 boys = 3 units/day

Efficiency of 12 girls = 2 units/day

Total work = 30 units

Time taken by boys and girls together to complete the work = 30/(3 + 2)

⇒ 30/5 = 6 days

∴ 15 boys and 12 girls work together and complete the work in 6 days.
